Calls for out-of-hours animal welfare officer

Councillors have asked for an animal welfare officer to be on call at night and at weekends, after a rise in reports of stray horses on the city's roads.

At this month's metropolitan district meeting, a motion asked the council to look at the cost of an out-of-hours service, and to report back before the end of the year.

"People are ringing and nobody answers," one councillor said. Officials said the matter would be examined as part of next year's budget.
